note: Servers measured by scripts/mcp-index.mjs. Versions are pinned so a rerun measures the same code. env values are placeholders: tools/list is answered without a valid credential by these servers. {tmp} in args is replaced with the OS temporary directory.

servers.name: ctxcap
servers.note: This repository's own server, measured from mcp/server.js.

servers.name: Sentry
servers.note: Default skill set. --skills or --disable-skills can expose fewer tools.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools
servers.note: Needs a Chrome install only to call a tool; tools/list is answered without one.

servers.name: Playwright
servers.note: Needs a browser only to call a tool; tools/list is answered without one.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.note: Archived by its maintainers in 2025; still widely installed.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.note: Reference server. The allowed directory changes what it may read, not the tool definitions.

servers.name: Everything
servers.note: Reference server used to exercise protocol features, not a production tool.

servers.name: Browserbase
servers.note: Its maintainers have marked the package unmaintained.

unmeasured.name: Supabase
unmeasured.reason: Exposes no tools until a project is linked, so there is nothing to measure at startup.

unmeasured.name: Cloudflare
unmeasured.reason: Requires a product name as a subcommand; there is no single default tool list.

unmeasured.name: Redis
unmeasured.reason: Connects to Redis before answering initialize, so it does not start without a reachable database.
